1.0.1.en: Added Zigbee Dongle E/P, SNZB-04P, ZBMINI, and SNZB-02LD/WD drivers, plus settings fixes for ZBMINIR2/MINI-ZBD.

1.0.5.en: Availability tracking for mains-powered devices (ZBMINI, ZBMINIR2, MINI-ZB1GP/GSP, SNZB-06P, Zigbee Dongle E/P), with a Traffic and Rejoins overview in the app settings. New devices: MINI-ZB2GS 2-gang switch, SNZB-05P water leak sensor and SNZB-09P siren. SNZB-04P battery reporting and SNZB-06P fixes.

1.0.6.en: Fix icons. Availability tracking for the battery sensors (SNZB-02LD/WD, SNZB-04P/PR2), using each sensor's own heartbeat.

1.0.7.en: Battery sensors: if a SNZB-04P/04PR2 or SNZB-02LD/WD shows as unavailable while idle, remove and re-pair it. MINI-ZB1GP: metering-error and overload alarms. BASICZBR3: availability tracking. Poll Control read is retried when the sensor wakes. Removed the MINI-ZB1GSP, SNZB-05P, SNZB-09P and S60ZBTPF drivers (no hardware to test them).

1.0.8.en: Availability is simpler and lighter: a device is marked unavailable after 5 commands in a row get no answer ("No response to commands") or after a long silence, and comes back as soon as it talks again. Nothing is stored any more, so after an app restart every device starts as seen now. Battery sensors are no longer read while they sleep (Poll Control reads removed, one attempt for the battery and calibration reads at start), which means far fewer failed transmissions. MINI-ZB1GP: the Electrical Monitoring limits (overcurrent, overpower, overvoltage, undervoltage) are now shown as read-only settings. New device: Sonoff Basic DIN Rail switch BASIC-ZB1GSP (relay with power and energy monitoring; relay, readings and overload protection tested on real hardware).

1.0.9.en: MINI-ZB1GP: voltage and current now reach the app on their own and the periodic reads are ten times less frequent (every 10 minutes instead of 2), and the energy counters now roll over at local midnight instead of 21:00 (UTC). BASIC-ZB1GSP (Sonoff Basic DIN Rail switch): power and current appear within seconds of a change, and the protection limits are read again if the first read fails at start.
